verdict.MOBILE_NOT_LINKED.sentence: TODO_HI: Your identity check is not finished, and the phone number on your Aadhaar cannot receive the code.
verdict.MOBILE_NOT_LINKED.why: TODO_HI: PM-KISAN checks who you are before it releases money. The usual way is a one-time code sent to the phone number linked to your Aadhaar. No number is linked to yours, so that code has nowhere to go, and waiting longer will not change it. You need a route that does not use a code: a Common Service Centre can finish the check in person with your Aadhaar card.
verdict.MAPPER_INACTIVE.sentence: TODO_HI: Your bank has not linked your Aadhaar to your account, so the money has nowhere to land.
verdict.MAPPER_INACTIVE.why: TODO_HI: PM-KISAN does not send money to an account number. It sends money to your Aadhaar, and your bank keeps a live link between the two. Yours is switched off, so each instalment is approved and then has nowhere to go. Only your bank branch can switch it back on, and it takes about 7 to 10 working days after they do.
verdict.LAND_NAME_MISMATCH.sentence: TODO_HI: Your land record is in a different name from your Aadhaar, so your state has paused your payment.
verdict.LAND_NAME_MISMATCH.why: TODO_HI: Your state checks that the person claiming the money is the person on the land record. Yours reads {land_name} while your Aadhaar reads {aadhaar_name}. Until those agree the state will not release the instalment. This cannot be fixed online: the village revenue officer has to correct the land record, which usually takes about 30 days.
verdict.FTO_IN_QUEUE.sentence: TODO_HI: Your ₹{amount} has been approved and is on its way. It should reach you by {expected_by}.
verdict.FTO_IN_QUEUE.why: TODO_HI: Nothing is blocking your payment. It has passed every check and is waiting its turn to be paid out. If it has not reached your account by {expected_by}, that is the point to act: come back here and we will tell you which office to take it to.
verdict.PAYMENT_OVERDUE.sentence: TODO_HI: Your ₹{amount} was due by {expected_by}. That was {days_overdue} days ago and it has still not arrived.
verdict.PAYMENT_OVERDUE.why: TODO_HI: Your payment passed every check and was queued for release, so nothing is wrong with your record. A payment this far past its date is stuck, not slow. Take your registration number {reg_no} to your Block Agriculture Officer and ask them to trace it. A payment pending {days_overdue} days is exactly what that office exists to chase.
verdict.ACCOUNT_DORMANT.sentence: TODO_HI: Your bank returned the money because your account has gone dormant.
verdict.ACCOUNT_DORMANT.why: TODO_HI: A bank freezes an account that has had no customer activity for a long time. The money was sent correctly and your bank refused it. Take your passbook and Aadhaar to your branch and ask them to make the account active again. Once it is active the next instalment arrives normally, and you can ask them to re-present the one that came back.
verdict.CREDITED.sentence: TODO_HI: ₹{amount} was paid into your account ending {last4} on {date}.
verdict.CREDITED.why: TODO_HI: This instalment is not missing. It reached your account on {date} and no message was sent to tell you. Ask at your bank counter for a passbook update, or check a mini statement for that date. If your passbook shows nothing on {date}, come back here and we will treat it as a failed payment.
verdict.INCOME_TAX_PAYER.sentence: TODO_HI: Your record is marked as an income tax payer for {year}, which the scheme treats as a reason to stop payment.
verdict.INCOME_TAX_PAYER.why: TODO_HI: PM-KISAN excludes farmers who paid income tax in the last assessment year. This flag is often wrong: it can come from a mistaken match on a similar name or an old tax number. If you did not pay income tax that year, the exclusion can be challenged with your Block Agriculture Officer. There is a second exemption that is missed constantly: Multi-Tasking Staff and Class IV or Group D employees are excluded from the government-service exclusion, so being a government employee in one of those grades does not disqualify you.
verdict.REGISTRATION_REJECTED.sentence: TODO_HI: Your application was not accepted, so no instalment can be paid. The reason recorded is: {reason}.
verdict.REGISTRATION_REJECTED.why: TODO_HI: A rejected application stops payment before any other check matters. Everything else in your record may be correct, and fixing your identity check or your bank link will not release this money while the application stands rejected. Take the recorded reason and your Aadhaar to a Common Service Centre and ask them to correct and resubmit it.
verdict.SYSTEM_UNREACHABLE.sentence: TODO_HI: We could not reach one of the government record systems, so we will not guess at your answer.
verdict.SYSTEM_UNREACHABLE.why: TODO_HI: Seven separate systems have to agree before your money moves, and one of them did not respond. We could show you a likely answer, but a wrong one would send you to the wrong office and cost you a day's wage. Your case is saved on this phone. Try again in a few minutes and we will check the rest for you.
verdict.REGISTRATION_PENDING.sentence: TODO_HI: Your application is still being checked, so no instalment can be paid yet.
verdict.REGISTRATION_PENDING.why: TODO_HI: New applications are checked against your state's land records before any money is released, and payments do not start until that finishes. If it has been more than 30 days since you applied, ask at a Common Service Centre what the current status is.
verdict.GOVT_EMPLOYEE.sentence: TODO_HI: Your record is marked as government service, which the scheme treats as a reason to stop payment.
verdict.GOVT_EMPLOYEE.why: TODO_HI: Serving and retired government employees are excluded from PM-KISAN. Multi-Tasking Staff and Class IV or Group D grades are exempt from that exclusion. If you are in one of those grades, take your service certificate to your Block Agriculture Officer and ask for the exclusion to be lifted.
verdict.PENSIONER.sentence: TODO_HI: Your recorded monthly pension is ₹{pension}, at or above the ₹{threshold} limit for this scheme.
verdict.PENSIONER.why: TODO_HI: Retired government employees drawing ₹{threshold} a month or more are excluded from PM-KISAN. Multi-Tasking Staff and Class IV or Group D grades are exempt. If your pension is lower than the amount recorded here, take your pension order to your Block Agriculture Officer and ask for the record to be corrected.
verdict.LAND_ACQUIRED_AFTER_CUTOFF.sente: TODO_HI: Your land is recorded as acquired on {acquired_on}, after the scheme cut-off of {cutoff}.
verdict.LAND_ACQUIRED_AFTER_CUTOFF.why: TODO_HI: PM-KISAN covers land held on or before {cutoff}. Land recorded as acquired after that date does not qualify. If you held this land earlier and the date of entry is wrong, the village revenue officer can correct it.
verdict.FAMILY_DUPLICATE.sentence: TODO_HI: Another member of your household is already receiving this benefit.
verdict.FAMILY_DUPLICATE.why: TODO_HI: The scheme pays one family once, and counts husband, wife and minor children as a single family. If the other person is not part of your household, take both registration numbers to your Block Agriculture Officer and ask for the records to be separated.
verdict.DOB_MISMATCH.sentence: TODO_HI: Your date of birth reads {on_record} here and {on_aadhaar} on your Aadhaar, so the identity check cannot finish.
verdict.DOB_MISMATCH.why: TODO_HI: The identity check compares your scheme record against Aadhaar field by field and stops if any of them differ. Two digits written the wrong way round is the usual cause. A Common Service Centre can correct the scheme record to match your Aadhaar. Take your Aadhaar card with you.
verdict.GENDER_MISMATCH.sentence: TODO_HI: Your gender is recorded differently here and on your Aadhaar, so the identity check cannot finish.
verdict.GENDER_MISMATCH.why: TODO_HI: The identity check compares your scheme record against Aadhaar field by field and stops if any of them differ. A Common Service Centre can correct the scheme record to match your Aadhaar. Take your Aadhaar card with you.
verdict.NAME_VARIANCE.sentence: TODO_HI: Your name reads {on_record} here and {on_aadhaar} on your Aadhaar, so the identity check cannot finish.
verdict.NAME_VARIANCE.why: TODO_HI: The two spellings have to match before the check will pass. A Common Service Centre can correct the scheme record to match your Aadhaar. Take your Aadhaar card, and ask them to change the scheme record rather than the Aadhaar.
verdict.EKYC_PENDING_ACTION.sentence: TODO_HI: Your identity check is not finished, so no instalment can be paid.
verdict.EKYC_PENDING_ACTION.why: TODO_HI: PM-KISAN checks who you are before releasing money, and yours has not been completed. You can finish it with a one-time code sent to the phone number linked to your Aadhaar, or in person at a Common Service Centre. It takes about 7 to 10 working days to take effect once it is done.
verdict.MAPPER_NOT_FOUND.sentence: TODO_HI: Your Aadhaar is not linked to any bank account, so the money has nowhere to land.
verdict.MAPPER_NOT_FOUND.why: TODO_HI: PM-KISAN pays to your Aadhaar rather than to an account number, and no bank has claimed that link for you. Take your Aadhaar and passbook to your bank branch and ask them to link your Aadhaar to your account. It takes about 7 to 10 working days to take effect.
verdict.MAPPER_DIFFERENT_BANK.sentence: TODO_HI: Your Aadhaar is linked to an account at {other_bank}, so the money is going somewhere you are not looking.
verdict.MAPPER_DIFFERENT_BANK.why: TODO_HI: Money follows the most recent bank that claimed your Aadhaar, and yours points at {other_bank}. Check that account first, because the instalment may already be sitting in it. If you want payments to arrive somewhere else, ask that bank to link your Aadhaar to the account you use.
verdict.LAND_NOT_SEEDED.sentence: TODO_HI: Your land record has not been attached to your application, so your state cannot approve the payment.
verdict.LAND_NOT_SEEDED.why: TODO_HI: Your state releases money only against a land record it can see, and yours is not attached to your application. Take your land document and Aadhaar to the village revenue officer and ask them to attach it. This usually takes about 30 days.
verdict.STATE_HOLD.sentence: TODO_HI: Your state has paused this payment and has not recorded a reason we can read.
verdict.STATE_HOLD.why: TODO_HI: State governments can hold a payment for checks of their own, and the reason is not always published. Your Block Agriculture Officer can see it on their screen. Take your registration number {reg_no} and ask them what the hold is for and what will clear it.
verdict.RFT_SIGNED.sentence: TODO_HI: Your state has approved this payment and passed it on. It should reach you by {expected_by}.
verdict.RFT_SIGNED.why: TODO_HI: Nothing is stuck. Your state has signed off and the payment has moved on to the central system. If it has not arrived by {expected_by}, come back here and we will tell you which office to take it to.
verdict.SETTLEMENT_PENDING.sentence: TODO_HI: The money has been sent and is settling at your bank. It should reach you by {expected_by}.
verdict.SETTLEMENT_PENDING.why: TODO_HI: The payment has left the government system and is with your bank. Banks usually take 1 to 3 working days to post it to your passbook. If nothing has appeared by {expected_by}, ask at your branch counter with your account number.
verdict.NOT_YET_QUEUED.sentence: TODO_HI: Your payment has not been placed in the queue for this instalment yet.
verdict.NOT_YET_QUEUED.why: TODO_HI: Nothing is blocking your record, but this instalment has not yet been picked up for release. It usually clears on its own within the payment cycle. If nothing has changed by {expected_by}, take your registration number {reg_no} to your Block Agriculture Officer.
verdict.BANK_RETURNED.sentence: TODO_HI: Your bank returned the payment, so your account details need correcting.
verdict.BANK_RETURNED.why: TODO_HI: The money was sent and your bank refused it. The usual causes are a wrong account number, a closed account, or a name that does not match the account. Take your passbook and Aadhaar to your branch and ask them why the credit was returned.
verdict.ACCOUNT_CLOSED.sentence: TODO_HI: The account on your record is closed, so your bank sent the money back.
verdict.ACCOUNT_CLOSED.why: TODO_HI: Payments cannot reach a closed account. Open an account or nominate one you already use, then ask that bank to link your Aadhaar to it. Until the link is live the next instalment will come back the same way.
verdict.NONE.sentence: TODO_HI: Nothing is blocking this payment.
verdict.NONE.why: TODO_HI: Every check has passed and no instalment is outstanding for this cycle.

real.row.6.note: TODO_HI: Our specification asks that the mock record endpoints not be reachable from outside the app. Inside a single deployment that cannot be enforced at the network layer, so they apply a same-origin check instead. They return synthetic data only.
